value.title: ADVANCED LEADER COURSE
value.description: Prepares squad leaders to lead, train and employ an infantry squad; covers troop-leading procedures, squad tactics and training management.

value.title: UNIT SUPPLY SPECIALIST COURSE
value.description: Upon completion of the course, the student will be able to receive, store and issue supplies; maintain hand receipts and property records; and operate an automated supply system. Credit recommendation: in the lower-division baccalaureate/associate degree category, 3 semester hours in supply management. (7/18)(6/20).

value.title: COMBAT LIFESAVER COURSE - IET
value.description: Trains non-medical soldiers to provide enhanced first aid: hemorrhage control, airway management and casualty evacuation.
